item.title: Webhooks Arrive Out of Order: How My Scheduler Killed Live Builds
item.description: The scheduler in ephemerd is event-driven. GitHub sends a workflow_job webhook when a job is queued, when it starts and when it completes, and ephemerd creates and destroys runners to match. For a while that worked well enough that I stopped thinking about it. Then a docker-build job failed with “The self-hosted runner lost communication with the server”, and when I pulled the node’s journal, ephemerd had destroyed that runner itself, on purpose, while it was running the build.
